# MCP bridge operation reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-mcp-contract.ts from src/mcp/contract — do not edit. Run `npm run mcp:contract`. -->

Contract 3.0.0 · protocol v3 · hash `ce8c3f559f6e` · 106 operations.
Full input/result JSON Schemas live in `src/mcp/contract/bridge-contract.json`; see `docs/MCP_BRIDGE_CONTRACT.md` for the protocol and contributor workflow.

Kinds: **read** (no change), **view** (UI/view state, not part of the saved document, no undo), **mutation** (one revision + one undo entry, rolled back on failure), **io** (export/cloud).
`destructive: no` means purely additive. `requires` lists auth/entitlement checks that return `AUTH_REQUIRED` / `ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED`.

## document

| Operation | Kind | Destructive | Requires | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `get_document` | read | no | — | Full native project session (.asciimtn v2) including layers, groups, effects, shaders, generators, typography, palettes and tool state. |
| `get_document_summary` | read | no | — | Compact structure: canvas, timeline, layers/groups with content-frame ranges, effects, shaders, selection and history flags. No cell data. |
| `read_cells` | read | no | — | Read cells at a timeline frame. scope "composite" = app compositor output (transforms, effects, generators; shaders excluded). scope "layer" = raw content frame data in layer-local coordinates. |

| `get_selection` | read | no | — | Current selection mask (cells, bounds) and clipboard availability. |

## project

| `set_typography` | mutation | yes | — | Set font, font size, character spacing and line spacing used for rendering/export. |

| Operation | Kind | Destructive | Requires | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `draw_brush_stroke` | mutation | yes | — | Pencil/eraser stroke through points with brush size and shape (aspect-ratio aware, respects selection mask). |

## batch

| Operation | Kind | Destructive | Requires | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `apply_operations` | mutation | yes | — | Apply up to 100 document mutations atomically: one revision, one undo entry, full rollback on any failure. Sub-operations must be non-nested document mutations (not undo/redo/new_project/load_project/apply_operations, reads, view, or io). Later steps see earlier steps' results; failures report details.index/details.op. |

## exclusions

Exclusions, partial coverage and runtime limits from `src/mcp/coverage-manifest.json`:

- **Brush, line, rectangle/ellipse, Bezier shape, paint bucket and gradient fill** (`drawing-tools`, supported): Bezier/shape rasterization uses the mounted canvas text metrics (UI_NOT_READY without a 2D canvas).
- **All app export formats rendered by the app exporters (no download side effect)** (`export`, supported): Text/code/session formats also render in jsdom; image/video formats need a browser canvas/encoder.
- **Cloud project list/save/open/delete/restore/metadata/download/upload** (`cloud-projects`, supported): Uses the signed-in browser session and the same validation and plan-limit gates as the app dialogs; failures keep the real reason (AUTH_REQUIRED, ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED, INVALID_INPUT, NOT_FOUND, LIMIT_REACHED). Builds without the premium package return UNSUPPORTED.
- **Publish to gallery and remix** (`cloud-community`, supported): Publish follows PublishToGalleryDialog; remix runs the gallery's own useRemix workflow (ban check, plan limit, attributed copy) and opens the copy. Builds without the premium package return UNSUPPORTED.
- **Sign-in, account settings, subscriptions/billing and admin tools** (`account-billing-admin`, excluded): Out of scope by decision: credentials, payment and admin actions stay with the signed-in user in the app UI.
